page_title: STR 1-0 HAV | Strasbourg v Le Havre 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Willy Delajod has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The ball goes out of play and Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+4' A second caution from Willy Delajod for Lucas Hogsberg (Strasbourg) means that he has to leave the pitch early today. It's a red card.
90+3' Substitution. Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) replaces Yassine Kechta.
90+3' Here is a change. Arouna Sangante is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre).
90+1' 1 - 0 Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) sends Mory Diaw the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
90+1' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is going to take the penalty!
90+1' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

89' Loic Nego (Le Havre) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement. Strasbourg are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
86' Le Havre force their opponents to concede a corner.
86' A cross from Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
84' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
82' The game has come to an end for Diego Moreira. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Martial Godo (Strasbourg).
80' A quickly taken corner by Strasbourg.
76' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is being substituted because of an injury. Didier Digard sends Simon Ebonog on the pitch.
76' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Mory Diaw.
76' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Strasbourg out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
75' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
70' Substitution. Rafael Luis is replaced by Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg).
69' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Fode Doucoure is replaced by Reda Khadra (Le Havre).
69' Substitution. Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Rassoul Ndiaye walks off.
67' The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
64' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Mory Diaw comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' Strasbourg are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
62' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) meets a cross inside the box, but Mory Diaw wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
60' Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
60' CLOSE! Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar.
54' Mike Penders makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom left corner by Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
52' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
51' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
48' What an excellent shot, but not the luckiest one. Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) fires the ball from inside the penalty box but it only hits the left post!
46' Liam Rosenior makes a half-time substitution. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) comes on in place of Mathis Amougou.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Liam Rosenior probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ben Chilwell. He is replaced by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
46' The game is over for Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg). Kendry Paez comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Le Havre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
42' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
42' Le Havre are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
39' Lucas Hogsberg (Strasbourg) is yellow-carded.
39' A pass by Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Hogsberg (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
27' Loic Nego (Le Havre) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
26' Willy Delajod blows his whistle as Issa Soumare (Le Havre) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
23' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Penders intercepts the ball.
19' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
17' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Ally Samatta (Le Havre) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
13' Strasbourg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
6' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
4' Le Havre will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
3' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.

3' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Mike Penders shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
2' Half-chance! Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) plays a pass into the box, but Mory Diaw reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
